title: Gaze Target Estimation Anywhere with Concepts
abstract: arXiv:2608.11367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating human gaze targets from images in-the-wild is an important and formidable task. Existing approaches primarily employ brittle, multi-stage pipelines that require explicit inputs, like head bounding boxes and human pose, in order to identify the subject of gaze analysis. As a result, detection errors can cascade and lead to failure. Moreover, these prior works lack the flexibility of specifying the gaze analysis task via natural language prompting, an approach which has been shown to have significant benefits in convenience and scalability for other image analysis tasks. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the Promptable Gaze Target Estimation (PGE) task, a new end-to-end, concept-driven paradigm for gaze analysis. PGE conditions gaze prediction on flexible user text or visual prompts (e.g., "the boy in the red shirt" or "person in point [0.52, 0.48]") to identify a specific subject for gaze analysis. translated_title: 基于概念的全方位注视目标估计
translated_abstract: 从野外图像中估计人类注视目标是一项重要且艰巨的任务。现有方法主要采用脆弱的、多阶段的流程，需要明确的输入（如头部边界框和人体姿态）来识别注视分析的受试者。因此，检测误差可能级联并导致失败。此外，这些先前工作缺乏通过自然语言提示来指定注视分析任务的灵活性，而这种方法已被证明在其他图像分析任务中在便利性和可扩展性方面具有显著优势。为克服这些局限，我们引入了可提示注视目标估计（PGE）任务，这是一种用于注视分析的新的端到端、概念驱动范式。PGE将注视预测条件化为灵活的用户文本或视觉提示（例如，“穿红衬衫的男孩”或“点[0.52, 0.48]处的人”）以识别特定受试者进行注视分析。这种方法引入了...
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的端到端概念驱动范式PGE，通过自然语言或视觉提示灵活指定注视分析对象，克服了传统多阶段流程的脆弱性和级联误差问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel end-to-end concept-driven paradigm PGE that flexibly specifies gaze analysis subjects via natural language or visual prompts, overcoming the brittleness and cascading errors of traditional multi-stage pipelines.
